question:
Select the correct synonym of the word

EXTORTIONATE
solution:
The correct answer is "**exorbitant**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Extortionate**: extremely expensive. (अत्यधिक)
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• ​**Exorbitant**:
 (of a price or amount charged) unreasonably high. (अत्यन्त,हद से ज़्यादा)
 
 
• 
 **Exotic**: originating in or characteristic of a distant foreign country. (विदेशी)
 
 
• **Exorcist**: 
 a person who expels or attempts to expel a supposed evil spirit from a person or place. (ओझा,जादू देनेवाला)
 
 
• **Exonerate**: 
 (of an official body) absolve (someone) from blame for a fault or wrongdoing. (निर्दोषी ठहराना, विमुक्त करना)
 
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the words, "**exorbitant**" is the synonym of the given word.
 
• The implied meaning of the given word in the** first paragraph** of the passage is that the trip cannot be missed, despite its expensive cost.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**
